title: Geometry - Lesson 6 Practice: Angle Pairs
description: Practice identifying adjacent, vertical, linear pair, and supplementary angles, then solving missing-angle relationships.

questions.question: Which description matches adjacent angles?
options: Opposite angles formed by intersecting lines
Two angles that share a vertex and one side without overlapping
Any two angles with equal measures
Any two angles whose measures add to 90 degrees
questions.explanation: Adjacent angles share a vertex and a common side, and their interiors do not overlap.

questions.question: Two lines intersect. Which pair of angles must be congruent?
questions.explanation: Vertical angles are opposite angles formed by intersecting lines, and they have equal measures.

questions.question: Every linear pair is supplementary.
questions.explanation: A linear pair forms a straight angle, so the two measures add to 180 degrees.

questions.question: All adjacent angles are supplementary.
questions.explanation: Adjacent angles only have to share a vertex and side. They are supplementary only when they form a straight line or otherwise add to 180 degrees.

questions.question: If $x^\circ$ and $72^\circ$ are supplementary, then $x = $ ______.
questions.explanation: Supplementary angles add to 180 degrees, so x = 180 - 72 = 108.

questions.question: Two vertical angles have measures $(3x)^\circ$ and $81^\circ$. Find $x$.
questions.explanation: Vertical angles are equal, so 3x = 81 and x = 27.

questions.question: Explain why two angles in a linear pair add to $180^\circ$.
questions.correctAnswer: They are adjacent and their non-common sides form a straight line, so together they make a straight angle measuring 180 degrees.
questions.explanation: The key idea is that a linear pair forms one straight angle.

questions.question: A diagram shows two intersecting lines. One angle measures $118^\circ$. Give the measures of its vertical angle and one adjacent angle.
questions.correctAnswer: The vertical angle measures 118 degrees, and each adjacent angle measures 62 degrees.
questions.explanation: The vertical angle is equal to 118 degrees. An adjacent angle forms a linear pair with it, so 180 - 118 = 62 degrees.
